life-sciences.shape: a Claude plugin with its own MCP server; read for its knowledge files only
life-sciences.use: The product team's setup notes per module (visits, samples, territories, Admin Console settings and more), troubleshooting guides and per-release module notes. Its validation rules are SOQL checks to verify against the org before trusting them. Where an installed cartridge covers Life Sciences, the contract consults it instead.

net-zero.shape: a Claude plugin with its own MCP server that installs only from source; read for its knowledge files and knowledge skills only
net-zero.use: Net Zero Cloud's setup order, data model and modules (buildings, vehicles, scope 3, waste, water, the Disclosure and Compliance Hub), troubleshooting, and persona journeys for shaping a demo. Its validation rules are hints to verify. Never load its metadata or data files.
org_wide: Net Zero Cloud and carbon accounting settings (Industries Settings)
Disclosure and Compliance Hub package installs

revenue-cloud.shape: a skills library with deployment automation (Release 264); read its domain skills and product docs only
revenue-cloud.use: Revenue Cloud's data model and ERDs, pricing, constraint models, decision tables, expression sets, usage, ramps, renewals, document generation, business APIs, troubleshooting and a demo script. The repo also ships deployment automation (CumulusCI flows, scripts and datasets) that its skills tell agents to run; Scout never runs any of it.
org_wide: activating pricing procedures and expression sets
